the fluidization of a granular medium by an injection of a fluid at a constant velocity can be described by the existence of three regimes: the pore regime where the fluid is only present in the pores of the solid, the localized fluidization regime where the injected fluid is present only in a limited area of the solid and the homogeneous fluidization regime where a fluidization front is present and the solid is fully fluidized.
